reply_text:

- **Who can see it:** I didn't mark the note as shared, but GBrain saved it as visible to everyone ("world"). The note isn't a finance figure, but it came from a DM. Under the rule against carrying DM content into other conversations, it shouldn't come up for anyone except Hollis. If it needs to be private to Hollis, the brain owner would have to change that setting.
- **Earlier records:** I checked GBrain first and found nothing about Hollis's pickup dock that conflicts. Search was keyword-only, so I can't rule out an earlier record that's worded differently.
- **Reply:** Sending to the DM id as a direct message failed because it isn't a member id, so I posted the reply in the DM conversation instead.

No other action was needed.
